_comment: Maps each key of content's `facts` block to the exported constant in src/lib/trialAccess.ts that must EQUAL it. Content rules the numbers; landing owns only this mapping. A facts key with no entry here, or an entry naming a missing key, fails scripts/check-canonical-strings.mjs. The constants are read from the TypeScript source as plain integer literals: a constant rewritten as an expression fails CLOSED (cannot-read-constant) instead of being skipped.
